spec.candidate_spec: Location value given shape: the prediction of a model on shape, count, batter side and location, minus the prediction of the same model without location, averaged over a pitcher's pitches. Chosen on development folds that never read 2026 (baseball/pitch_quality/output/development_location.json: outcomes 2024 and 2025; r with next-season RV/100 +0.147, 90% interval +0.077 to +0.210, against +0.030 for the published features). train.py is unchanged until this test passes; the report is written as 3.0.0 and does not validate the published version.
spec.target: Next-season run value per 100 pitches (RV/100), MLB pitchers with 500+ pitches in both seasons
spec.decision_dates: season start (March 1 of the outcome season)
spec.group_by: none: a pitch-level model; pitcher identity is not a feature
spec.gate_decided: Matt, 2026-11-19: strict (the 90% interval of the edge must exclude zero), measured against the published Location+ features trained on the same fold. The partial correlation with next-season RV/100 given Stuff+ is reported with its interval and is not part of the gate. Chosen with the development folds in view (baseball/pitch_quality/output/development_location_gates.json): a gain in r over Stuff+ alone could not pass at this sample size (about +0.015 on a partial r of 0.10). Stuff+ and last season's results are reported baselines.
spec.reproduction: Exact on the same machine; across machines tolerance ±0.01 in r (Matt, 2026-11-13). Official runs happen in CI.

vault.note: No sealed season yet: the only test season is 2026. The 2027 season becomes the vault when it completes.

spec.amended: 2026-11-23: the `candidate: 3.0.0` line is removed. 3.0.0 passed this block and was promoted on Nov 20, so the block now tests the published version; nothing else in it changed. (3.0.1 is the same model, stored instead of refit.) `candidate_spec` stays as the record of how the spec was chosen.

entity_overlap.not_applicable: group_by: none: a pitch-level model; pitcher identity is not a feature

universe.note: entities without an outcome (retired, injured, too few pitches) can't be scored; they're counted here so survivorship is visible
